target.mission: ClayCode as a real programming language with compiler, virtual Clay Machine, self-contained runtime/environment, deep/direct Linux interoperability, general Internet/network connectivity, direct process/terminal execution, low-latency Clay data transformation, typed visual/image/video and audio transport, first-class optical/visual signal output, and a minimal ClayOS, delivered as exactly one executable file named EntityOS

execution_policy.go_rule: Exact go must perform build/test/experiment work only in isolated sandboxes and must never schedule, trigger, rely on, or promote VPS/self-hosted/production-host test execution as evidence.

CLAY_MACHINE.label: Clay Machine / EntityOS
CLAY_MACHINE.completion_law: PASS only when the canonical ClayCode language/compiler/runtime executes real programs in the virtual Clay Machine and all currently accepted Clay Machine capability gates are satisfied by the exact delivered artifact, which must be one executable file named EntityOS. The artifact must carry/bind the Clay environment and minimal ClayOS, cross Linux through explicit typed boundaries, provide the accepted typed visual/optical path, real network path, direct Linux process path, low-latency data path, image/video and audio transport, state/recovery/provenance requirements, and copy-and-run on a fresh compatible Linux target without mandatory installation or companion runtime files. Runtime-generated user state is permitted data, not a release sidecar. Component, synthetic, source-tree or out-of-path host success does not imply whole-machine PASS.

superseded_programs.law: Legacy Frank/self.root/UCM2/harness paths may contribute bounded implementation or regression evidence when semantics still match, but they do not select active work and they do not define completion.

trigger_target_rule: Every registered project trigger is a lens on CLAYVERSE_CLAY_MACHINE_ONLY and must re-enter ClayCode/compiler/VM/environment/Linux-interop/ClayOS/connectivity/portability/terminal/data-plane/media/typed-visual-signal code, tests, architecture, work items, or explicit negative results inside the one-file EntityOS product boundary. Exact go must load the fixed capability plan, preserve each capability stream's status/blockers, include them in frontier selection, and produce a concrete research/falsification/build/test/runtime delta whenever an unblocked high-information step exists. All build, test, experiment and runtime-validation execution must occur only inside isolated sandboxes; VPS, self-hosted VPS runners and production hosts are forbidden as test environments. Exact go must finish by rebuilding/testing EntityOS in sandbox when technically possible or naming the exact EntityOS blocker and next sandbox-executable step.
